en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty Twelfth Chapter
Regarding the discourse on the "one who goes from family to family": Should it not be said that "a person who goes from family to family is destined for the state of going from family to family"?
“Is he not one who goes from family to family?
If he is one who goes from family to family, then indeed it must be said:
"A person who goes from family to family is destined for the state of going from family to family.
The Discussion on One Who Goes from Family to Family is finished.
